title: Yeasty Zesty Irish Fish Fried-Rice
description: Crispy, yeasty fried-rice dish with Irish flair, paleo-friendly ingredients, and a tangy beurre-monte sauce. Features dashi broth for added depth.
instructions: Heat dashi broth in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add cooked Irish salmon and stir to combine.
Add chopped fresh dill, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
In a large skillet or wok, melt 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter over medium-high heat.
Add paleo-friendly brown rice and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Push rice to one side of the skillet; add remaining 1 tablespoon of unsalted butter to the other side.
Once butter is melted, pour beurre-monte sauce over the rice and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Stir in cooked salmon mixture and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Transfer fried-rice to a serving platter and garnish with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
